items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: We had the first one, he's dead, Harry Shannon. Then I had, we had Henrikh Konek with us. And we had Dan Tyler playing sax. We had a wonderful little jazz band.

ctx.x: How many cornets did you use with Shields? Two.

We had the first one, he's dead, Harry Shannon. Then I had, we had Henrikh Konek with us. And we had Dan Tyler playing sax. We had a wonderful little jazz band. And at that time we were, we were, you see, in them days, most of these bands would run around playing with nothing but chords. You know what I mean? But they'd stick on the chords and funny facts. But George, we played music. Then we used to mix it in. You know what I mean? And we harmonized, you see? Then they had that wind jam, you know what I mean?…
Who did he have in the rhythm section then?
